content.snl: %The built-in runtime palette contains rule (green), const (blue), bvar (purple), binder (orange), fvar (red), and structurally transparent sub. There is no built-in rewrite entry. The default light/dark pairs deliberately retain the same legacy colors; use an explicit host/workspace palette for intentional dark styling. This repository supplies its own themed palette without changing the shared runtime defaults.%
content.markdown: The built-in runtime palette contains rule (green), const (blue), bvar (purple), binder (orange), fvar (red), and structurally transparent sub. There is no built-in rewrite entry. The default light/dark pairs deliberately retain the same legacy colors; use an explicit host/workspace palette for intentional dark styling. This repository supplies its own themed palette without changing the shared runtime defaults.
